name: Universal TV Click-to-Zoom Images
description: Click any image to view it fullscreen on TV, click again to close

params.code: var overlay = document.createElement('div'); overlay.id = 'tv-img-overlay'; overlay.style.cssText = 'display:none;position:fixed;top:0;left:0;width:100vw;height:100vh;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.92);z-index:999999;justify-content:center;align-items:center;cursor:pointer;'; overlay.addEventListener('click', function() { overlay.style.display = 'none'; }); var zoomImg = document.createElement('img'); zoomImg.style.cssText = 'max-width:90vw;max-height:90vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);'; overlay.appendChild(zoomImg); document.body.appendChild(overlay); document.querySelectorAll('img').forEach(function(img) { if (img.naturalWidth > 100 && img.naturalHeight > 100) { img.style.cursor = 'zoom-in'; img.addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); zoomImg.src = this.src; overlay.style.display = 'flex'; }); } }); return 'image-zoom-ready';
